title: Kagamine Len — Sharing Deliciousness〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It's finished...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's a nice three-step Jacob's ladder.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks. I feel like I've gotten faster at making them.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanna play. Lemme try next...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Okay, just give me a second to undo it.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? Mizuki?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Oh, perfect!
I have something for you guys♪

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Ta-daa!
They're pretzels that my big sis brought back for me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You have more snacks? But you've already given us so much...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That chocolate was really good.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Believe it or not, she forgot to unpack some stuff. While sorting everything out, all these other snacks and souvenirs fell out of her bags.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, I decided to share them with you guys.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Umm... It'd be nice to eat them with you again.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, sorry. I've got dinner soon, so I have to get right back.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: So, you guys feel free to share them amongst yourselves!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Anyway, I gotta head back!
Let me know what you guys think of these later!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: That was fast...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
What should we do with these...?
Umm... P-Pret...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Prechels...? Did I hear that right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I guess...?
Lemme see the bag.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
B-r-e-z...?
What language is this, again?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't know...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
These ones appear to be covered in chocolate.
They look like little hearts.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They look like people's faces to me.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh? P-People's faces...?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: These holes are the eyes, and this one's the mouth.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You're right...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: S-Stop it, you guys. I'm gonna be too afraid to eat them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Don't worry. They won't feel scary if we have them together.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, in that case, I wanna invite MEIKO and KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: They might not want to have them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... I know...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But they still haven't had any of the other snacks Mizuki brought over, either.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Come to think of it...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Did you really leave them here, Len?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I put them all back in the big bag...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, what's wrong, you three?
Are you looking for something?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh, Luka... Have you seen a big bag of snacks around here?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They were from Mizuki's sister, and those were MEIKO and KAITO's shares...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I'm sorry. I thought they were leftovers, so I ate them all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Yes, Luka ended up eating them by accident.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah... That's why I want to have these prechels with MEIKO and KAITO...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: In that case, we shouldn't eat these until we find them.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks, Miku, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Why does it feel like we're always looking for them...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Let's do our best to find them...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah...!
